content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: SCA and MOTO ## slug: sca ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End **Strong Customer Authentication and Mobile Orders/Telephone Orders** Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), as part of PSD2 regulation in Europe, requires changes to how European customers authenticate online {{variable.Product_Stripe}} payments. Card payments require a different process, namely 3D Secure, in order to meet SCA requirements. We've updated {{variable.Product_Payments}} to prevent {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s from being declined by banks. Read more [here](https://stripe.com/guides/strong-customer-authentication). ## Who is Affected? The new requirements for SCA affect our customers in Europe who use {{variable.Product_Stripe}} as that is where the PSD2 regulation is being implemented. Read more [here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Payment_Services_Directive#Revised_Directive_on_Payment_Services_(PSD2)). ## Scope ### Recommended Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}} supports the following features. * Capturing a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} through ***PayLink*** with SCA regulated {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s. * Capturing a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} through ***Donations*** with SCA regulated {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s. ### Not Recommended * Capturing SCA regulated {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s and {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s through the ***{{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}}.*** * Capturing SCA regulated {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s through the ***{{variable.Object_Transaction}} object.*** These options require additional configuration and must be flagged as MOTO (mail orders & telephone orders) when sent to Stripe from the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} since the card is not present for authentication. MOTO puts a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} out of the scope of SCA. When SCA is applied, the business will benefit from a “liability shift” in their {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. This means that should fraud occur, the bank (as opposed to the company) will be liable to cover the costs as the bank authorized the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. Putting SCA exemptions in place returns the “liability shift” to the company. Therefore, a company needs to weigh the pros and cons of the liability shift before adding an exemption. This is why Stripe uses the MOTO parameter via API feature flagged, and it isn’t available by default. Blackthorn only applies MOTO to {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} and auto-processed {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s, as these types are out of scope for SCA. Please watch the below videos for instructions on how to enable SCA and MOTO. ### SCA ![Strong Customer Authentication](https://youtu.be/6PcPXwQz2e8){height="480" width="640"} :::(Warning) (Are you using SCA with Events?) To successfully use SCA with Events, you must use Stripe Checkout as SCA is only supported by Stripe. (SCA is not supported by Authorize.net or Spreedly.) ::: ### MOTO ![Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LWhlFg_46QQ){height="480" width="640"} ## How to Enable SCA {{snippet.SCA_Setup}} If you haven't done so already, set up Stripe Checkout. To support the SCA flow, Stripe Checkout must be used with Events. Click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/stripe-checkout-1){target=`_blank`} to learn how to set up Stripe Checkout. (SCA support is only available through Stripe.) ## Payment Gateway Configuration for MOTO Before using MOTO to create and capture payments from the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}}, you must add the {{variable.Field_PG_StripeMOTOEnabled}} field to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record page layout. When {{variable.Field_PG_StripeMOTOEnabled}} = "True" (checked), the MOTO flag will be set on Stripe charge requests. In other words, your {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s will succeed when using a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} that doesn't require additional authentication. ![H_02_22_pg config for moto](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_22_pg%20config%20for%20moto.png){height="" width=""} ## Payment Method Configuration for MOTO If you need to create new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s from the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} object and capture {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s from the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object, you must add the {{variable.Field_PM_EnableMOTO}} field to the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}'s Charge Card page layout. When {{variable.Field_PM_EnableMOTO}} = "True" (checked), the MOTO flag will be set on Stripe charge requests so that {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s can be captured without going through two-factor authentication. ![H_02_22_pm config for moto](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_22_pm%20config%20for%20moto.png){height="" width=""} ## Contact Stripe to Configure Your Stripe Account To charge a newly created SCA regulated credit card number in the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} and {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object, you must contact Stripe support to have your Stripe account configured for MOTO. 1. Reach out to Stripe Support to get your Stripe Account “Gated” for MOTO.*Navigation: Stripe Support Site from Help Menu > Click Contact Support > This will initiate a chat with support.* 2. Stripe will ask you why you need this. Tell them that you need to take over the phone payments through the API with the Blackthorn App. 3. Make sure Stripe Support gates MOTO for your account in Test and Live mode. ## Testing SCA for PayLink Use the following test card to prompt for additional authentication -> `4000002500003155` Other regulatory (3D Secure) test cards can be found [here](https://stripe.com/docs/testing#regulatory-cards). **If you have any questions about this or need help with testing, please don't hesitate to reach out to {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}}.** ## What Errors Will I See if My Stripe Account Has Not Been Setup for MOTO Payments? If your Stripe account has not been gated for MOTO by the Stripe support team you will notice that your {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s will fail when you try to capture a charge from the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object or the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} for new SCA regulated {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s. **What Does This Look Like?** - When capturing a charge from the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} object and MOTO is not gated on the Stripe Account: ![H_02_22_errors 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_22_errors%201.png){height="" width=""} - When a capturing a charge from the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} and MOTO is not gated on the Stripe account: ![H_02_22_errors 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_22_errors%202.png){height="" width=""} *Failure message from Virtual Terminal* ![H_02_22_errors 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_22_errors%203.png){height="" width=""} *Error message on the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record that was created from the Virtual Terminal* ## What Does the Additional Authentication Step Look Like? When using features like {{variable.Product_PayLink}}, the flow of the UI has an additional step. This step supports the additional authentication process. In live mode, customers will navigate to the PayLink as they've done in the past. After clicking **PAY** customers will be asked to verify their identity with a push notification, a text message, or another method chosen by their bank. Read more [here](https://stripe.com/guides/strong-customer-authentication). ## What About Existing Payment Methods? Existing {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s that are saved in your orgs should continue to work with the new SCA regulations. Also, {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s that do not require the additional authentication step will continue working as expected. ## How Will SCA affect Stripe Billing? If you need to enable SCA in your Salesforce org, existing {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s used with your Stripe Billing records will continue working as expected. If you set up a new {{variable.Object_Subscription}} through Salesforce and it requires a new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}, you must authorize the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} before the Stripe Subscription will appear as "Active" in the Stripe dashboard. ### How Do I Make Sure My Card Is Authorized? * Use an existing, valid {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}. * Create a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} in the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}}. * Create a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} through the **New Payment Method** button on a Contact/Account record. ### **How Can I Use the Stripe Dashboard to Authorize a Payment Method** If you create a new {{variable.Object_Subscription}} in Salesforce that requires a new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} and push it Stripe, you will see that the Subscription shows as incomplete. This is because the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} still needs to be authorized. Complete the authorization step in Stripe. 1. Navigate to the Subscription in Stripe. 2. Click on the "Open" Invoice associated with the Subscription record. 3. In the Details section of the Invoice in Stripe, click the link next to "Payment Page." 4. Complete the authorization process and capture the payment. ![H_02_22_errors 4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_22_errors%204.png){height="" width=""} ## Frequently Asked Questions **Q: Will existing, valid credit card {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s still work after SCA is enabled?** - Yes! Valid credit card {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s will continue to work as expected after you enable SCA. **Q: Will existing, valid ACH {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s still work after SCA is enabled?** - Yes! New and existing ACH {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s will continue to work as expected after you enable SCA. **Q: If SCA is enabled and I use Plaid with Stripe, will I encounter any issues?** - No, with SCA Enabled you can still continue to use Plaid without issue or interruption. **Q: If I enable SCA and use Events and PayLink, will there be any issues with Event registration?** - To successfully use SCA with Events, you must use Stripe Checkout as SCA is only supported by Stripe. (SCA is not supported by Authorize.net or Spreedly.) **Q: If I enable SCA and use DocumentLink and PayLink, there will there be any issues with DocumentLink?** - No, DocumentLink will continue to work without issue after SCA is enabled for cards NOT requiring authentication. SCA-ready support for DocumentLink is on our product roadmap. **Q: With SCA enabled, can I can use PayLink and Donations checkout and the Payment Method can be used for future recurring payments (without having to re-verify)?** - Yes! Once the Card has been authenticated through the PayLink or Donations checkout, that Payment Method can be used for future or recurring payments without additional authentication. **Q: With SCA enabled, can I create ACH Payment Methods through PayLink or Donations and reuse them in the future?** - Yes! ACH Payment Methods are not affected by SCA regulations. **Q: With the Virtual Terminal, can I capture payments the same way before SCA was enabled?** - Yes, but with some additional setup. Please see the additional setup needed here.
